known_failed_routes: ARM direct S3: connection reset during multipart upload
Intel direct S3: connection reset during multipart upload
conclusion: No documented non-invasive local flag or archive transformation was found that fixes this crash. The strongest supported new variable is network environment, preserving the signed app and archive.

next_supported_proposal.action: Use the same Mac, existing keychain profile, and exact archive on a materially different network, such as an operator-provided phone hotspot, with any VPN disabled by its operator. Do not repeat until that environment changes.
next_supported_proposal.why: Apple DTS explicitly recommends this diagnostic for Soto multipart failures. A related crash report identifies NWConnection state-update recursion and a reporter succeeded in another execution environment.
next_supported_proposal.authority: Root chooses and coordinates any local network change; reviewer changed nothing.
evidence_to_capture: Changed network condition, without exporting network credentials
Distinct tool command and log, uploader exit and definitive completed upload
Only after upload completion: Accepted status/log and usual staples/trust
next_supported_proposal.uncertainty: This is a diagnostic and plausible recovery, not a confirmed fix for StackOS. The same crash has also occurred on another Mac and occasionally CI.

other_options.disposition: Only worth one bounded attempt if root finds a materially newer installed version. Not a guaranteed fix: Apple DTS reproduced environmental differences with the same 1.1.3 (42) binary, newer than our 1.1.0 (39). No official fixed-version claim located.
The matching reporter succeeded on GitHub Actions. This requires an already authorized upload environment with its own available credentials; do not export secrets or create accounts just to try it.

other_options.option: Notary REST API with a different S3 uploader
other_options.disposition: Officially supported alternative that avoids notarytool's SwiftNIO uploader, but it requires App Store Connect API authentication and secure handling of temporary upload credentials. It is a separate integration effort, not the smallest recovery within the present no-secret-export scope.

other_options.option: Submit signed DMG instead of ZIP
other_options.disposition: Apple supports notarizing an outer container, but there is no evidence this fixes the upload crash/reset. It changes the archive and adds proof work while keeping the same failing transport; not recommended as the next blind retry.

rejected_or_unsupported_shortcuts: Further permutations of the four already failed architecture/endpoint routes without another changed condition
Global defaults or arbitrary upload timeout tweaks: a matching reporter tried nt-upload-connection-timeout=300 without fixing the crash
Disabling Bluetooth/Handoff/awdl0 or suspending system daemons: reported only to alter failure timing, not to resolve it
Treating JSON/no-progress or verbose logging as a fix; no primary evidence supports that claim
Chunk-size/concurrency override: no documented notarytool control located in the primary sources reviewed
Rebuilding or re-signing the reviewed app to solve an uploader failure
Treating a submission ID/In Progress as proof that upload completed

sources.classification: Apple DTS primary diagnosis plus clearly identified reporter experience
supported_facts: DTS locates recursion in Network.framework stateUpdateHandler of NWConnection, with notarytool recursively exhausting its stack.
Reporter obtained Accepted results from a different runner; disabling local system-network activity did not completely fix local failures.
DTS distinguishes incomplete crashed submissions from genuine pending analysis.
The same archive and same notarytool version succeeded for DTS but failed for the reporter.
DTS calls the trigger environmental and offers no confirmed workaround.
For Soto multipart connectivity failures, try a different network; a phone hotspot is a valid test and a VPN should be disabled.
The reporter later succeeded after environment changes, but the exact causal change was not isolated.
Container notarization is supported; both known endpoint routes have already been tried here.
For nested distributions, Apple supports notarizing the outermost signed container; this is a valid packaging choice, not evidence of an upload-recovery fix.
A submission includes the SHA256 of the exact software to upload to S3; direct Notary API exists as an alternative to the CLI.

reviewer_actions: Read public primary sources and wrote this evidence file. No upload, provider call, tool installation, network setting change, global environment change, credential access/export, source/artifact mutation, or account creation.
